title: Start a YouTube channel
outcome: Publish your first polished video and shorts in a weekend.
summary: Go from idea to a published long-form video plus short clips, using AI for scripting, voice, editing and thumbnails while you stay the creative director.

steps.title: Find an angle and write the script
steps.description: Brainstorm 10 video ideas for your niche, pick one, and turn it into a script with a strong hook in the first 10 seconds.
steps.tip: Ask for three alternative hooks and read them out loud before choosing.

steps.title: Record or generate the voiceover
steps.description: Record yourself, or generate a natural voiceover if you prefer to stay off-camera.

steps.title: Edit by editing text
steps.description: Edit the video like a document: delete filler words, add b-roll and captions automatically.

steps.title: Design a click-worthy thumbnail
steps.description: Create a bold thumbnail with a face or object, 3–4 words max and high contrast.

steps.title: Repurpose into Shorts
steps.description: Let AI find the best moments and turn them into vertical clips with captions.

title: Make faceless short-form videos
outcome: A week of Reels, Shorts or TikToks without showing your face.
summary: Script, generate visuals, add a voice and captions, then schedule a week of short videos from a single idea.

steps.title: Batch-write scripts
steps.description: Turn one topic into seven 30-second scripts, each with a hook, one insight and a call to action.

steps.title: Generate the visuals
steps.description: Create short cinematic clips for each scene, or use stock-style footage generated from text.

steps.title: Add a voice
steps.description: Generate a consistent voice for your channel so every video sounds on-brand.

steps.title: Edit and caption
steps.description: Assemble clips, add music and word-by-word captions sized for mobile.

steps.title: Schedule the week
steps.description: Queue posts at your audience's peak times across platforms.

title: Launch a podcast
outcome: Record, clean up and publish an episode with show notes and clips.
summary: Plan the episode, record remotely in high quality, fix the audio with AI and turn one recording into notes, transcripts and social clips.

steps.title: Plan the episode
steps.description: Outline segments and questions, and research your guest.

steps.title: Record in studio quality
steps.description: Record locally on each side so the audio stays crisp even if the internet drops.

steps.title: Clean up the audio
steps.description: Remove background noise, echo and filler words in one pass.

steps.title: Transcript and show notes
steps.description: Generate a transcript, summary, chapters and key takeaways for your podcast page.

steps.title: Promote with clips
steps.description: Cut the best moments into vertical clips with captions.

title: Write and publish a blog post that ranks
outcome: A well-researched, SEO-optimized article with original images.
summary: Research with sources, draft in your voice, polish the writing, optimize for search and create custom images.

steps.title: Research the topic
steps.description: Gather facts, stats and what competing articles cover, with sources you can cite.

steps.title: Outline and draft
steps.description: Build an outline around reader questions, then draft section by section in your own voice.

steps.title: Polish the writing
steps.description: Fix grammar, tighten sentences and adjust tone.

steps.title: Optimize for search
steps.description: Check keywords, headings and content gaps against top-ranking pages.

steps.title: Create custom images
steps.description: Generate a header image and simple diagrams instead of generic stock photos.

title: Build a brand identity from scratch
outcome: A name, logo, color palette and starter website for your idea.
summary: Define positioning, generate logo concepts, create consistent brand visuals and launch a simple website.

steps.title: Clarify positioning and name
steps.description: Describe your audience and promise, then brainstorm names and taglines and check domain availability.

steps.title: Design the logo
steps.description: Generate logo concepts, shortlist three and test them at small sizes.

steps.title: Create brand visuals
steps.description: Build templates for social posts, cards and slides in your colors and fonts.

steps.title: Launch a website
steps.description: Generate a site from a prompt, then edit copy and sections visually.

title: Launch a landing page that converts
outcome: A live landing page with persuasive copy and a sign-up form.
summary: Write conversion-focused copy, wireframe the page, build it without code and capture leads.

steps.title: Write the copy
steps.description: Generate headline, benefits, objections and call-to-action variations.

steps.title: Wireframe the layout
steps.description: Turn the copy into a section-by-section wireframe.

steps.title: Build and publish
steps.description: Generate the page from a prompt or your wireframe and publish on your domain.

steps.title: Capture sign-ups
steps.description: Add a short form and connect responses to your email list or sheet.

title: Fill a month of social media content
outcome: A month of on-brand posts written, designed and scheduled.
summary: Turn a few core ideas into a full content calendar with captions, visuals and automated scheduling.

steps.title: Plan content pillars
steps.description: Pick 3–4 themes your audience cares about and generate 30 post ideas across them.

steps.title: Write captions
steps.description: Generate platform-specific captions and hashtags in your brand voice.

steps.title: Design the visuals
steps.description: Create carousels and post images from templates.

steps.title: Schedule and measure
steps.description: Schedule everything, then review what performs best each week.

title: Build a working app without coding
outcome: A clickable, deployed web app built from a description.
summary: Write a clear spec, generate the UI, let an AI app builder create the full app, then connect automations.

steps.title: Write a product spec
steps.description: Describe users, main screens, data and the one thing the app must do well.
steps.tip: Ask the assistant to list edge cases and empty states.

steps.title: Generate the interface
steps.description: Create UI components and screens from your spec.

steps.title: Build the full app
steps.description: Generate a working app with a database and login, then iterate by chatting.

steps.title: Connect automations
steps.description: Send emails, update sheets or post to Slack when things happen in your app.

title: Ship code faster as a developer
outcome: Plan, write, review and document features with AI pair programmers.
summary: Use AI at each stage of development: planning, coding in your editor, reviewing pull requests and documenting architecture.

steps.title: Plan the change
steps.description: Paste the requirement and relevant files; ask for a step-by-step implementation plan and risks.

steps.title: Code with an AI editor
steps.description: Implement in small steps with an assistant that understands your whole codebase.

steps.title: Review pull requests
steps.description: Get automated review comments on bugs, security and style before a human review.

steps.title: Diagram the architecture
steps.description: Keep a living diagram of services and data flow for the team.

title: Automate your repetitive work
outcome: Hours saved each week by automating copy-paste tasks.
summary: Map a manual process, automate it step by step, and add AI where judgment or writing is needed.

steps.title: Map the process
steps.description: Draw the steps you repeat, where data comes from and where it goes.

steps.title: Automate the steps
steps.description: Connect your apps with triggers and actions; start with one simple flow.

steps.title: Add AI where it helps
steps.description: Insert AI steps to classify, summarize or draft responses inside the flow.

steps.title: Delegate to an agent
steps.description: For multi-step tasks, try an AI agent with limited permissions and human approval.

title: Never take meeting notes again
outcome: Automatic notes, action items and follow-ups for every meeting.
summary: Schedule smarter, record and summarize meetings, push action items to your task list and send follow-ups in minutes.

steps.title: Schedule without back-and-forth
steps.description: Share availability links and let AI protect focus time.

steps.title: Record and summarize
steps.description: Let a notetaker join calls and produce summaries, decisions and action items. Always tell participants.

steps.title: Turn actions into tasks
steps.description: Move action items into your workspace with owners and due dates.

steps.title: Send the follow-up
steps.description: Draft a short recap email from the summary and send it the same day.

title: Create a great presentation in an hour
outcome: A clear, good-looking deck with a strong storyline.
summary: Research, structure the story, generate slides and replace generic visuals with custom ones.

steps.title: Gather facts
steps.description: Collect the key facts and numbers with sources.

steps.title: Shape the story
steps.description: Write one key message per slide and order them as a story: problem, insight, solution, next step.

steps.title: Generate the slides
steps.description: Turn the outline into designed slides and adjust layouts.

steps.title: Add custom visuals
steps.description: Create specific images or diagrams for key slides.

title: Analyze data without writing code
outcome: Clear charts and insights from your spreadsheet in minutes.
summary: Upload your data, ask questions in plain language, build a dashboard and present the findings.

steps.title: Clean and explore
steps.description: Upload a CSV or connect a sheet; ask the tool to spot missing values and outliers.

steps.title: Ask questions
steps.description: Ask for trends, comparisons and charts in plain English, and check the formulas it used.

steps.title: Build a dashboard
steps.description: Create a dashboard your team can refresh.

steps.title: Present the findings
steps.description: Turn the three most important insights into a short deck.

title: Study smarter for exams
outcome: Understand topics deeply and retain them with active recall.
summary: Use AI as a patient tutor, turn your own notes into study guides, practice with flashcards and get step-by-step help with math.

steps.title: Learn with a tutor
steps.description: Ask for explanations at your level, then have the tutor quiz you instead of giving answers.

steps.title: Study your own material
steps.description: Upload lecture notes and readings; ask for summaries, study guides and practice questions.

steps.title: Practice with flashcards
steps.description: Turn weak areas into spaced-repetition flashcards.

steps.title: Solve math step by step
steps.description: Check your working and understand each step, not just the answer.

title: Write a literature review
outcome: A structured review of the research on your question, with real citations.
summary: Find relevant papers, check what the evidence says, extract key findings and draft a well-cited review.

steps.title: Find papers
steps.description: Search by research question and explore citation networks to find key papers.

steps.title: Check the evidence
steps.description: See whether studies support or contradict a claim and how often they are cited.

steps.title: Summarize papers
steps.description: Extract methods, results and limitations into a comparison table.

steps.title: Draft and polish
steps.description: Draft themes and gaps from your table, then edit for clarity. Verify every citation yourself.

title: Learn a new language
outcome: Daily practice that builds speaking confidence, not just vocabulary.
summary: Combine a structured course with open conversation practice, accurate translation and listening practice.

steps.title: Daily lessons
steps.description: Build a streak with short structured lessons and AI explanations of mistakes.

steps.title: Conversation practice
steps.description: Role-play real situations (ordering food, small talk) and ask for corrections.

steps.title: Translate and check
steps.description: Check natural phrasing for things you want to say.

steps.title: Train your ear
steps.description: Listen to articles read aloud in your target language.

title: Research any topic fast
outcome: A sourced briefing on any topic, saved to your knowledge base.
summary: Search with citations, go deep on your own sources, synthesize a brief and save it where you can find it again.

steps.title: Search with sources
steps.description: Ask specific questions and open the cited sources for important claims.

steps.title: Go deep on documents
steps.description: Upload PDFs and articles and ask questions across all of them.

steps.title: Synthesize a brief
steps.description: Write a one-page brief: what we know, what is uncertain, what to do next.

steps.title: Save to your second brain
steps.description: Store the brief with links so it compounds over time.

title: Make your own song
outcome: An original song with lyrics, vocals and cover art.
summary: Write lyrics, generate a full song, create instrumentals or stems for remixing and design cover art.

steps.title: Write lyrics
steps.description: Describe the story and mood; iterate on verses and chorus until they feel like yours.

steps.title: Generate the song
steps.description: Choose genre, tempo and vocal style; generate takes and extend the best one.

steps.title: Create instrumentals
steps.description: Make royalty-free background tracks for videos or practice.

steps.title: Split stems to remix
steps.description: Separate vocals, drums and bass to remix or practice along.

steps.title: Design cover art
steps.description: Create square artwork that reads well as a small thumbnail.

title: Create AI art and illustrations
outcome: A consistent set of illustrations in your own style.
summary: Develop ideas, generate images, refine details and prepare print- or web-ready files.

steps.title: Develop the concept
steps.description: Describe the scene, style references and mood; ask for detailed prompts.

steps.title: Generate images
steps.description: Generate variations, then reuse seeds or style references to stay consistent.

steps.title: Refine details
steps.description: Fix hands, extend backgrounds or change parts of the image with generative fill.

steps.title: Upscale for print
steps.description: Upscale to high resolution without losing detail.

title: Create product photos and listings that sell
outcome: Studio-quality product photos and descriptions for your store.
summary: Shoot with your phone, remove backgrounds, place products in lifestyle scenes and write listings that convert.

steps.title: Clean product shots
steps.description: Remove backgrounds and fix lighting from simple phone photos.

steps.title: Lifestyle scenes
steps.description: Place products in realistic scenes that match your brand.

steps.title: Write the listing
steps.description: Generate benefit-led product descriptions with your keywords.

steps.title: Create ads
steps.description: Turn photos into ad creatives and social posts.

title: Plan a trip in minutes
outcome: A day-by-day itinerary within your budget.
summary: Generate an itinerary around your interests, find flights and stays, and be ready to communicate abroad.

steps.title: Build the itinerary
steps.description: Share dates, budget and interests; get a day-by-day plan and adjust it.

steps.title: Find flights and stays
steps.description: Search with natural language and compare options.

steps.title: Handle the language
steps.description: Translate menus, signs and messages accurately.

steps.title: Budget check
steps.description: Ask for a daily cost estimate and money-saving swaps.

title: Get fit with an AI coach
outcome: A workout and nutrition plan that adapts to your progress.
summary: Get an adaptive training plan, track nutrition and recovery, and ask questions any time. Consult a professional for medical concerns.

steps.title: Get a training plan
steps.description: Share your goal, schedule and equipment; let the plan adapt as you log workouts.

steps.title: Fix your nutrition
steps.description: Build sustainable habits rather than strict diets.

steps.title: Track recovery
steps.description: Use sleep and strain data to decide when to push and when to rest.

steps.title: Ask anything
steps.description: Get explanations of exercises and adjustments for travel or busy weeks.

title: Redesign a room
outcome: See your room in new styles and get a plan to make it real.
summary: Visualize styles from a photo, plan the layout in 3D and turn it into a shopping list within budget.

steps.title: Visualize styles
steps.description: Upload a photo of the room and try different styles.

steps.title: Plan the layout
steps.description: Measure the room and test furniture placement in 3D.

steps.title: Make a shopping list
steps.description: Turn your favorite design into a prioritized list within budget.

title: Add an AI support chatbot to your website
outcome: Answer common customer questions 24/7 with human handoff.
summary: Organize your knowledge, train a chatbot on it, and connect it to your CRM with a clear path to a human.

steps.title: Organize your knowledge
steps.description: Collect FAQs, policies and help articles in one place and fill gaps.

steps.title: Build the chatbot
steps.description: Train a bot on your content and test it with real questions.

steps.title: Connect to your CRM
steps.description: Log conversations and route complex cases to your team.

title: Make a training or explainer video
outcome: A professional explainer or onboarding video without a film crew.
summary: Script the message, present it with an AI avatar, add screen demos and polish the edit.

steps.title: Write the script
steps.description: Keep it to 90 seconds with one idea per scene.

steps.title: Present with an avatar
steps.description: Choose a presenter and voice; generate the talking segments.

steps.title: Record screen demos
steps.description: Record the product steps and let AI tidy them up.

steps.title: Final edit
steps.description: Combine segments, add captions and music.

title: Create an online course
outcome: A structured course with video lessons and quizzes.
summary: Design the curriculum, build slides, record or generate lessons, add quizzes and captions.

steps.title: Design the curriculum
steps.description: Define learner outcomes and break them into modules and lessons.

steps.title: Build lesson slides
steps.description: Turn each lesson outline into clean slides.

steps.title: Record lessons
steps.description: Record yourself, or generate presenter videos for scripted lessons.

steps.title: Add quizzes
steps.description: Create quizzes to check understanding after each module.

steps.title: Caption everything
steps.description: Add accurate captions and transcripts for accessibility.

title: Land your next job
outcome: A tailored resume, sharp cover letters and interview confidence.
summary: Tailor your resume to each role, research companies, write cover letters and practice interviews with AI feedback.

steps.title: Tailor your resume
steps.description: Paste the job description and your resume; ask which achievements to emphasize and what is missing.

steps.title: Research the company
steps.description: Learn about recent news, products and culture with sources.

steps.title: Polish your cover letter
steps.description: Make it specific and concise, and fix tone and grammar.

steps.title: Practice interviews
steps.description: Run mock interviews by voice or text and ask for honest feedback on structure.

title: Put your personal finances on autopilot
outcome: A clear budget, tracked spending and smarter money habits.
summary: Track spending automatically, build a realistic budget and understand your money with plain-language explanations. Not financial advice.

steps.title: Track spending automatically
steps.description: Connect accounts read-only and let AI categorize transactions.

steps.title: Get nudges and insights
steps.description: Get friendly nudges on spending and savings goals.

steps.title: Understand the concepts
steps.description: Ask for plain-language explanations of budgeting, debt and investing basics.

title: Write a story or book
outcome: A finished draft with a solid plot and a consistent voice.
summary: Plan your plot and characters, draft with an AI writing partner, revise and create cover art.

steps.title: Plan plot and characters
steps.description: Develop premise, characters and a chapter outline through conversation.

steps.title: Draft with a writing partner
steps.description: Write scenes yourself and use AI to unblock, describe or brainstorm what happens next.

steps.title: Revise and edit
steps.description: Tighten prose and fix grammar while keeping your voice.

steps.title: Design a cover
steps.description: Generate cover concepts, then finalize typography by hand.

title: Run sales outreach that gets replies
outcome: Personalized outreach at scale and a pipeline you can track.
summary: Build a target list, research prospects, write personalized sequences and log everything in your CRM.

steps.title: Build a target list
steps.description: Find companies and contacts that match your ideal customer profile.

steps.title: Personalize the outreach
steps.description: Generate personalized first lines and short sequences; review before sending.

steps.title: Track the pipeline
steps.description: Log replies and meetings automatically and get AI deal summaries.

steps.title: Learn from calls
steps.description: Record and summarize sales calls to improve your pitch.
